additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425002-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P9 170000982] Charging Issue CRM:02699000109
additional_info.body:
Hi Poland Team,
Thanks for sharing the backend logs and we have analysed the charging logs by taking the reference of the logs that you have provided. We see there are multiple charging session in which Status: SuspendedEV in the StatusNotification schema. The charging session was not aborted in multiple occasions while having the SuspendedEV. This is cause from the EV side and there is no issue from the EVSE. There are many reason by which the SuspendedEV arises which are stating below.
The EV battery is temporarily not accepting power (e.g., it's balancing cells).
The EV is regulating the charge current and has chosen to pause.
The vehicle software decided to stop charging due to temperature, voltage conditions, etc.
Please let me know if you have anu further query to discuss if not we shall proceed with closing this ticket by tomorrow EOD.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

Hi,
Yes, we well know everything about SuspendedEV, but the question was about behavior charging session authorized via RFID.
Error description:
The charging station went from the Finihing state to the Preparing
state after a completed charging session via RFID. This results in the inability to charge for parking.
The situation occurred during integration testing with an eMSP
operator.
BR
Konrad
